complicacoes.texto: Despero is obsessed com proving his Força through conquest.

Despero’s attempts to conquer Earth have been thwarted several times by the Justice League, e he is particularly obsessed com destroying them. ALLIES Though there is none he considers an equal, Despero has al - lied himself com villains ranging from Johnny Sorrow to the time-travelling Time Stealers when he needs them to accom - plish his goals. When Starro once challenged Despero’s place as the supreme interstellar conqueror, he joined the forces led by Brainiac 2 (Vril Dox), until Starro had been utterly defeated. ENEMIES Any who stand between Despero e his goal are his en - emies, doubly so for those who have stood in his way e bested him in the past, including the Justice League.
